dct_title_s: North Sea, Netherlands--Germany, mouth of the Ems River (Raster Image)
dct_description_sm: Prepared and published by the National Imagery and Mapping Agency. Depths shown by isolines and soundings. Relief shown by spot heights. "From a German chart of 1997." "Reprinted by NIMA 1-98." Place names in German (Plattdeutsch) and Dutch with glossary in English. "Copyright 1997 by the United States Government. No copyright claimed under Title 17 U.S.C." "Soundings in meters." Insets: A. Fischerbalje and the harbor of Borkum. Scale 1:15,001 at 53°33ʹ30ʺN -- B. Eemshaven. Scale 1:19,992 at 53°27ʹN. Map No. 37222.
This map is part of a collection of scanned and georeferenced nautical charts produced by the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA).
